preparations.title: Roast chicken thighs and broccoli
preparations.method: Toss chicken and broccoli florets in olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast at 200C for 35-40 minutes until chicken is golden and cooked through.

preparations.title: Beef and green pepper stir-fry
preparations.method: Slice peppers into strips. Stir-fry beef and peppers in a hot pan with oil until beef is browned and peppers are tender-crisp.

preparations.title: Boiled white potatoes
preparations.method: Peel and chop potatoes into chunks. Boil in salted water for 15-20 minutes until tender. Drain and cool.

preparations.title: Steamed basmati rice
preparations.method: Rinse rice and boil in double the volume of water for 10-12 minutes until fluffy. Drain and cool.
